Title: Customer Registration and Login
Preconditions: MongoDB running, Backend API started
Steps: 1. Navigate to /register | 2. Fill in name, email, password, phone | 3. Select role "customer" | 4. Click Sign Up | 5. Verify redirect to homepage | 6. Logout | 7. Navigate to /login | 8. Enter same email and password | 9. Click Sign In
Test Data: Name: John Doe, Email: john@example.com, Password: test123, Phone: 555-1234, Role: customer
Expected Result: User successfully registers, receives JWT token, redirects to homepage. Upon re-login, user authenticates successfully and sees customer portal header.

Title: Dealer Registration with Dealer Code
Preconditions: MongoDB running, Backend API started
Steps: 1. Navigate to /register | 2. Fill in name, email, password | 3. Select role "dealer" | 4. Enter dealer code | 5. Click Sign Up | 6. Verify redirect and "Dealer Platform" header displayed
Test Data: Name: Jane Dealer, Email: jane@dealer.com, Password: dealer123, Role: dealer, Dealer Code: DEALER001
Expected Result: User registers as dealer, dealer code is stored, user sees "Dealer Platform" label in header after login.

Title: Financial Institution Registration
Preconditions: MongoDB running, Backend API started
Steps: 1. Navigate to /register | 2. Fill in name, email, password | 3. Select role "financial_institution" | 4. Click Sign Up | 5. Verify redirect and "Financial Portal" header displayed
Test Data: Name: Bank User, Email: bank@finance.com, Password: bank123, Role: financial_institution
Expected Result: User registers as financial institution, sees "Financial Portal" label in header, has access to loan applications.

Title: Dealer Adds Vehicle to Inventory
Preconditions: Logged in as dealer with dealer code DEALER001
Steps: 1. Navigate to /dealer-dashboard | 2. Click "Add Vehicle" | 3. Fill in all vehicle fields | 4. Submit form | 5. Verify vehicle appears in inventory list
Test Data: Make: Toyota, Model: Camry, Year: 2024, VIN: ABC123XYZ, Base Price: 30000, Stock: 5, Color: Blue
Expected Result: Vehicle is created with dealer code DEALER001, basePrice and currentPrice are set, stock quantity is 5, status is available.

Title: Customer Views Available Vehicles and Real-Time Inventory
Preconditions: Logged in as customer, vehicles exist with stock > 0
Steps: 1. Navigate to /inventory | 2. Observe vehicle list | 3. Note stock quantities | 4. Dealer reduces stock in parallel | 5. Customer refreshes page | 6. Verify updated stock displayed
Test Data: Existing vehicles with varying stock levels
Expected Result: Customer sees only available vehicles with stockQuantity > 0. When dealer updates stock, changes reflect immediately after refresh.

Title: Customer Books Vehicle with Inventory Update
Preconditions: Logged in as customer, vehicle with stock > 1 available
Steps: 1. Navigate to /bookings | 2. Select available vehicle | 3. Fill in deposit and notes | 4. Submit booking | 5. Navigate back to inventory | 6. Verify vehicle stock decreased by 1
Test Data: Vehicle stock: 3, Deposit: 500, Notes: "Urgent booking"
Expected Result: Booking created with status "pending", vehicle stock reduced to 2, bookingPrice locked to current dynamic price, booking shows confirmation number when confirmed.

Title: Customer Schedules Test Drive
Preconditions: Logged in as customer, vehicle available
Steps: 1. Navigate to /test-drives | 2. Click schedule test drive | 3. Select vehicle | 4. Choose date/time | 5. Add notes | 6. Submit request | 7. Verify status is "requested"
Test Data: Vehicle: 2024 Toyota Camry, Scheduled: 2026-05-10 10:00 AM, Notes: "Prefer morning slot"
Expected Result: Test drive created with status "requested", customer name/email auto-filled from user profile, awaits dealer approval.

Title: Dealer Approves Test Drive Request
Preconditions: Logged in as dealer, test drive requested for dealer's vehicle
Steps: 1. Navigate to /test-drives | 2. See pending test drive | 3. Click approve | 4. Add dealer notes | 5. Submit | 6. Verify status "approved"
Test Data: Test Drive ID from TC-007, Dealer Notes: "Confirmed slot"
Expected Result: Test drive status changes to "approved", approvedBy and approvedAt fields populated, customer sees updated status.

Title: Customer Applies for Loan
Preconditions: Logged in as customer, vehicle selected
Steps: 1. Navigate to /loans | 2. Click apply for loan | 3. Select vehicle | 4. Enter requested amount, term, income, credit score | 5. Submit application | 6. Verify status "submitted"
Test Data: Vehicle: 2024 Toyota Camry, Amount: 25000, Term: 60 months, Income: 75000, Credit Score: 720
Expected Result: Loan application created with userId, applicant name/email auto-filled, status "submitted", awaits review by financial institution.

Title: Financial Institution Reviews and Approves Loan
Preconditions: Logged in as financial_institution, loan application exists
Steps: 1. Navigate to /loans | 2. View loan application | 3. Click review | 4. Set status "approved" | 5. Enter approved amount and interest rate | 6. Add decision notes | 7. Submit
Test Data: Loan ID from TC-009, Approved Amount: 25000, Interest Rate: 4.5, Notes: "Approved with standard terms"
Expected Result: Loan status updated to "approved", reviewedBy and reviewedAt populated, approvedAmount and interestRate set, customer sees approval.

Title: Customer Views AI Recommendations
Preconditions: Logged in as customer, browsing history exists, preferences set
Steps: 1. Navigate to /inventory | 2. View recommendations section | 3. Verify vehicles match preferences | 4. Click on a vehicle to view | 5. Check browsing history updated
Test Data: User preferences: Makes [Toyota Honda], Price Range 20000-40000, Browsing history includes similar makes
Expected Result: Recommendations endpoint returns vehicles matching preferences and similar to browsing history, sorted by recommendation score, limited to 10 results.

Title: Dynamic Pricing Updates Based on Demand
Preconditions: Vehicle exists with basePrice 30000, viewCount 50, bookingCount 5
Steps: 1. View vehicle details | 2. Note current price | 3. Simulate 100 additional views | 4. Trigger pricing update | 5. Verify price increased
Test Data: Vehicle base price: 30000, Initial views: 50, New views: 150, Bookings: 5
Expected Result: currentPrice recalculated using demandFactor and inventoryFactor, price increases due to higher demand (views and bookings), lastPriceUpdate timestamp updated.

Title: Complete Vehicle Purchase Workflow
Preconditions: Fresh database, dealer and customer registered
Steps: 1. Dealer logs in and adds vehicle | 2. Customer logs in and views inventory | 3. Customer books vehicle | 4. Customer schedules test drive | 5. Dealer approves test drive | 6. Customer applies for loan | 7. Financial institution approves loan | 8. Customer confirms booking
Test Data: Full workflow from vehicle creation to loan approval
Expected Result: All entities created with correct relationships, vehicle stock decremented, booking confirmed with confirmation number, test drive approved, loan approved, all role-based permissions enforced.

Title: Multi-Role Interaction: Dealer Inventory and Customer Booking
Preconditions: Dealer logged in with 3 vehicles, customer logged in
Steps: 1. Dealer updates vehicle stock to 1 | 2. Customer views inventory | 3. Customer books last unit | 4. Verify vehicle status changes to "reserved" | 5. Another customer attempts to book same vehicle | 6. Verify booking fails
Test Data: Dealer: DEALER001, Vehicle: Last unit in stock, Second customer: different user
Expected Result: First booking succeeds, vehicle stock becomes 0, status changes to "reserved", second booking fails with error "Vehicle is not available for booking".

Title: Booking Vehicle with Zero Stock
Preconditions: Vehicle exists with stockQuantity 0
Steps: 1. Customer logs in | 2. Navigate to bookings | 3. Attempt to book vehicle with 0 stock | 4. Verify error message
Test Data: Vehicle ID with stock 0
Expected Result: Booking fails with 400 error: "Vehicle is not available for booking", no booking created, vehicle stock unchanged.

Title: Test Drive Time Slot Conflict
Preconditions: Test drive already scheduled for vehicle at 10:00 AM
Steps: 1. Customer logs in | 2. Schedule test drive for same vehicle at 10:30 AM (within 1-hour window) | 3. Submit | 4. Verify conflict error
Test Data: Vehicle: Same as existing test drive, New time: 2026-05-10 10:30 AM
Expected Result: Test drive creation fails with 400 error: "Time slot conflict for this vehicle", no new test drive created.

Title: Dynamic Pricing with Low Stock
Preconditions: Vehicle with stock 1, basePrice 30000
Steps: 1. Check current price | 2. Verify inventory factor increases price | 3. Book vehicle (stock becomes 0) | 4. Trigger price recalculation | 5. Verify further price increase
Test Data: Stock: 1, Base Price: 30000
Expected Result: Price increases due to low stock (inventoryFactor > 1), when stock reaches 0, price calculation reflects scarcity, price higher than base.

Title: Dealer Attempts to Delete Another Dealer's Vehicle
Preconditions: Dealer A logged in, Vehicle belongs to Dealer B
Steps: 1. Dealer A navigates to vehicle list | 2. Attempts DELETE /api/vehicles/{vehicleB_id} | 3. Verify 403 error
Test Data: Dealer A code: DEALER001, Vehicle dealer code: DEALER002
Expected Result: Request fails with 403 error: "You can only delete your own vehicles", vehicle not deleted.

Title: Customer Updates Profile Preferences
Preconditions: Customer logged in
Steps: 1. Navigate to profile (via /api/auth/me endpoint) | 2. Update preferences: makes [Toyota Honda], priceRange {min: 20000 max: 40000} | 3. Submit update | 4. View recommendations | 5. Verify recommendations align with new preferences
Test Data: Preferences: makes [Toyota Honda], priceRange min 20000 max 40000
Expected Result: User preferences updated, subsequent recommendations query filters by updated makes and price range, relevant vehicles returned.

Title: Dealer Views Bookings for Own Vehicles Only
Preconditions: Dealer logged in, bookings exist for dealer's vehicles and others
Steps: 1. Dealer navigates to /bookings | 2. Verify only bookings for dealer's vehicles displayed | 3. Verify other dealers' bookings not visible
Test Data: Dealer code: DEALER001, Bookings for DEALER001 vehicles and DEALER002 vehicles exist
Expected Result: Dealer sees only bookings where vehicleId belongs to vehicles with dealerCode DEALER001, other bookings filtered out.

Title: Financial Institution Views All Loan Applications
Preconditions: Financial institution logged in, multiple loan applications exist
Steps: 1. Navigate to /loans | 2. Verify all loan applications visible | 3. Filter by status | 4. Review application details
Test Data: Multiple loan applications with statuses: submitted, under_review, approved
Expected Result: Financial institution sees all loan applications regardless of user, can update status to approved/rejected, reviewedBy field set to their userId.

Title: User Registration with Duplicate Email
Preconditions: Email already registered

Test Data: Email: existing@example.com
Expected Result: Registration fails with 400 error: "Email already registered", no new user created, no token issued.

Title: Login with Invalid Credentials
Preconditions: User exists with email test@example.com
Steps: 1. Navigate to /login | 2. Enter email test@example.com | 3. Enter incorrect password | 4. Submit | 5. Verify error
Test Data: Email: test@example.com, Password: wrongpassword
Expected Result: Login fails with 401 error: "Invalid email or password", no token issued, user not authenticated.

Title: Dealer Registration Without Dealer Code
Preconditions: Registering as dealer role
Steps: 1. Navigate to /register | 2. Select role "dealer" | 3. Leave dealer code empty | 4. Fill other fields | 5. Submit | 6. Verify error
Test Data: Role: dealer, Dealer Code: empty
Expected Result: Registration fails with 400 error: "Dealer code required for dealer accounts", no user created.

Title: Customer Attempts to Access Dealer Dashboard
Preconditions: Logged in as customer
Steps: 1. Navigate to /dealer-dashboard | 2. Verify access denied or redirect
Test Data: User role: customer
Expected Result: Access denied with 403 error or redirect to login, "Insufficient permissions" or "You don't have permission to access this page" message displayed.

Title: Unauthenticated Access to Protected Routes
Preconditions: No authentication token
Steps: 1. Attempt GET /api/bookings without token | 2. Verify 401 error | 3. Attempt POST /api/bookings without token | 4. Verify 401 error
Test Data: No Bearer token in Authorization header
Expected Result: All protected routes return 401 error: "Authentication required", no data returned, user redirected to login on frontend.

Title: Booking Vehicle That Does Not Exist
Preconditions: Customer logged in
Steps: 1. Navigate to bookings | 2. Attempt to book vehicle with non-existent ID | 3. Submit | 4. Verify error
Test Data: Vehicle ID: 507f1f77bcf86cd799439011 (non-existent)
Expected Result: Booking fails with 404 error: "Vehicle not found", transaction rolled back, no booking created.

Title: Test Drive Scheduling for Non-Existent Vehicle
Preconditions: Customer logged in
Steps: 1. Navigate to test drives | 2. Select non-existent vehicle ID | 3. Choose date/time | 4. Submit | 5. Verify error
Test Data: Vehicle ID: invalid or non-existent
Expected Result: Test drive creation fails, error indicates vehicle not found or invalid vehicleId, no test drive record created.

Title: Loan Application Without Required Fields
Preconditions: Customer logged in
Steps: 1. Navigate to loans | 2. Leave requestedAmount or termMonths empty | 3. Submit | 4. Verify validation error
Test Data: Missing requestedAmount or termMonths
Expected Result: Loan application fails validation, 400 error returned with message indicating required fields, no loan application created.
